card.name: Math and science modeling in academic text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and name pieces inside academic descriptions of mathematics, engineering or biology research, such as 'and' in 'Operations Research and the Management Science'. It also fires inside a few control-system and equation terms.

modes.label: Linking words in research blurbs
modes.description: Words like 'and', 'the', 'a' and 'of' inside news-style descriptions of mathematical biology or cancer modeling work.
modes.example: The work recently received international recognition from the worldwide Institute for Operations Research<< and>> the Management Science (INFORMS)

modes.description: Pieces of technical names such as differential equations or control systems.
